title: Treat Circle Mint fiat mint/redemption as a scoped actual-capital series, separate from on-chain volume and XRP demand

feature_contract.name: circle_mint_net_fiat_conversion_usd
feature_contract.sign_convention: positive=net fiat conversion into USDC through Circle Mint customers; negative=net USDC conversion back to fiat
feature_contract.provenance: Circle SEC 10-Q; report period and publication timestamp preserved
exclusions: on-chain transfers between existing USDC holders
non-Circle-Mint distribution routes not included in the filing's metric
feature_contract.point_in_time_rules: Do not use a filing before its public filing timestamp in backtests; retain both period-end and publication timestamps.
feature_contract.feature_admission: CONTEXT_ONLY; not an XRP directional feature

decisions: Record Q2 2026 gross mint USD83.004B, redemption USD86.784B, net -USD3.780B.
Record H1 2026 gross mint USD156.543B, redemption USD158.540B, net -USD1.997B.
Record 2025 comparatives separately: Q2 net +USD1.357B; H1 net +USD17.476B.
Do not treat the gross flows as unique new capital or as all USDC market activity; they are customer-initiated Circle Mint fiat conversions.
Record Coinbase-agreement distribution costs and the derived 78.7% Q2 / 80.0% H1 ratios, but label the denominator precisely as total distribution, transaction and other costs.
Do not equate these ratios with Coinbase's share of USDC balances, reserve income, total distributor payouts or XRP demand.
Use these measures only in stablecoin issuer economics and macro context until a point-in-time, source-independent, out-of-sample test demonstrates incremental predictive value.
rationale: Circle Q2 2026 10-Q lines 1598-1605 explicitly defines mint/redemption as fiat conversion initiated by Circle Mint customers.
Circle Q2 2026 10-Q lines 1628-1631 discloses Coinbase agreement cost mechanics and amounts.
Circle Q2 2026 10-Q lines 1507-1510 states distribution costs to key distributors such as Coinbase and Binance depend on platform balances and actions/policies the company does not control.
next_action: Reconcile Circle Q3 mint/redeem, USDC circulation and Coinbase distribution costs when the Q3 filing is published; compare with exchange netflows and stablecoin market-cap changes without treating them as interchangeable.
